key_insight: SpeechParaling-Bench greatly expands paralinguistic coverage and provides a standardized, cross-lingual benchmark (English–Chinese) to more reliably evaluate how well LALMs generate and preserve fine-grained paralinguistic cues.
problem_solved: Existing evaluations for paralinguistic-aware speech generation are limited by coarse feature coverage (<50 features) and inconsistent, subjective assessment methods; this work delivers a comprehensive dataset and protocol to enable finer, more reproducible evaluation.
method: Curate and label a broad set of >100 fine-grained paralinguistic features with more than 1,000 English–Chinese parallel speech samples to support cross-lingual analysis.
Define a standardized evaluation protocol combining objective signal metrics and structured subjective judgments to reduce ambiguity and improve reproducibility.
Provide benchmark tasks and baseline evaluations for LALMs to measure fidelity, expressiveness, and paralinguistic alignment.
impact: By supplying a detailed, multilingual benchmark and clear evaluation protocol, SpeechParaling-Bench enables ML practitioners to diagnose and improve LALMs' handling of subtle human cues—boosting naturalness and robustness in voice-based applications.
visual_elements: Feature-coverage radar chart comparing prior benchmarks (<50 features) vs SpeechParaling-Bench (>100 features).

paper_title: SpeechParaling-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Paralinguistic-Aware Speech Generation
paper_authors: Ruohan Liu, Shukang Yin, Tao Wang, Dong Zhang, Weiji Zhuang
